Overview of Selection Status

The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released a qualified list of male candidates (List-2) who successfully completed the Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Endurance Test (PET) for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) Examination, 2025. This stage serves as a mandatory requirement for candidates to progress toward the next phase of the recruitment process.

Important Information for Candidates

  • Authority: Staff Selection Commission (SSC).
  • Examination: SI in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces Exam, 2025.
  • Stage: PST/PET (Paper-II preparation).
  • Candidate Status: The published document confirms the eligibility of successful male candidates to appear for Paper-II.
  • Category Codes: The list utilizes specific classification codes to categorize candidates (e.g., 0 for EWS, 1 for SC, 2 for ST, 6 for OBC, and 9 for UR).

How to Verify Results

Candidates who participated in the PST/PET stages are advised to verify their status directly through official channels to avoid misinformation:

  • Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  • Navigate to the 'Results' section.
  • Locate the document titled "SI IN DELHI POLICE AND CENTRAL ARMED POLICE FORCES EXAM., 2025 (PST/PET) LIST OF MALE CANDIDATES QUALIFIED IN PST/PET FOR APPEARING IN PAPER-II (LIST-2)."
  • Search for your specific roll number within the official PDF released by the commission.

*Note: Details regarding total vacancies, application fees, specific cut-off dates, and the schedule for Paper-II are not specified in the provided data. Please refer to the official notification for the most current recruitment timeline.*
